mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credential (user_id, password_hash, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, password_updated_at) VALUES (#{credential.userId}, #{credential.passwordHash}, #{credential.failedLoginCount}, #{credential.lockedUntil}, #{credential.lastLoginAt}, #{credential.passwordUpdatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credential SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= #{maxFailures} THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE NULL END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
